desc: eps -> the paper grid-searches epsilon and lambda per environment
(Appendix F); 0.1 in RELATIVE units is the value this repo runs and
is declared here rather than tuned on returns.
alpha: 0 -> alpha = eps. With one PGD step and an l2-normalised
direction that is the exact solution of the linearised inner max,
relative -> the released code's `* torch.abs(obs)` scaling, which URB
needs because its observation mixes a start time in seconds with
route counts. See CHECKLIST_ernie.md item EPS-2.
D = KL: paper Section 5.1, 'when optimizing stochastic policies (e.g.,
MAPPO), D can be taken to be the KL divergence'.
